description: Single storey rear extension, part single, part 2-storey front/side extension involving conversion of garage into habitable room, hip to gable roof extension involving rear dormer, front rooflights, with changes to fenestrations.
decision_conditions: The proposed two-storey side extension, in combination with the hip-to-gable roof enlargement and rear dormer extension, would by reason of its scale, massing, width and roof design result in an overly bulky, dominant and visually intrusive form of development. The proposal would erode the visual separation between neighbouring dwellings, create a harmful terracing effect, unbalance the appearance of the semi-detached pair and fail to appear subordinate to the original dwelling. As such, the development would be incongruous with the established character and appearance of the host property and surrounding street scene, causing unacceptable harm to local character and visual amenity. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD8, DMD13, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Development Management Document (2014), and the design objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026).
